name: tier0_wall_face_review
_comment: THE WALL-FACE REVIEW SCENE. Authored for the §3 rounds (RULED, Rafe, 2026-08-26).
WHY IT EXISTS. corridor_junction.json is an excellent FLOOR instrument and a thin WALL
instrument. Under §3 a wall shows a front face only where floor lies to its SOUTH, and in a
one-tile-wide north-south corridor no flanking wall cell qualifies — so of its ~324 wall
cells only 22 could show a face at all, about 6%, in two rows either side of one branch.
Six blind critic rounds answered 'is there thickness' with no, and every one of those
verdicts rested on that thin strip. The ruling requires south-facing front faces PRESENT in
scene, so the scene has to put them there.
WHAT CHANGED, AND ONLY THIS. A second east-west branch. The trunk, the width, the height
and the one-tile rule are untouched, and the player now stands midway between two crossings
instead of below one. That quadruples the face rows in frame — y=7 and y=13 are true
south-facing walls (floor to their south, wall to their north) and y=9 and y=15 are their
opposite numbers.
corridor_junction.json IS NOT REPLACED. It is §6.4's instrument and the evidence already on
disk was taken through it; a scene swap would silently invalidate every comparison against
that record. This is a second spec, selected per capture.
THE TWO TRAPS THE ORIGINAL RECORDS STILL APPLY, and both are held here:
1. CORRIDORS ARE ONE TILE WIDE. A three-wide carve is a room: every cell in it has three or
more open neighbours, so the junction check passes trivially and the scene stops testing
what it claims to.
2. THE JUNCTION MUST SIT INSIDE THE LIT RADIUS. Both crossings are 3 tiles from the player
against a carried light reaching 5.5, and HasJunction scans y-then-x so the NORTHERN one
at (8,8) is the cell the capture-time luminance probe measures. If light.radius_tiles
drops below ~4 this spec must move the branches closer or the scene silently stops posing
its question.
Both branches are geometrically symmetric about the trunk, and the two crossings are
symmetric about the player's row. That symmetry is deliberate — a preference the critic
reports should come from the art, not the layout — and it is ALSO why the variant count is
chosen against PositionHash: at N=4 mirrored cells collide on every even offset and half
the map renders as a reflection of the other half. See tools/composition_spike/SPIKE.md §2.
Coordinates are tiles, (0,0) top-left. The outer ring stays solid wall.
